{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

14:## Unreleased

17:  (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)

22:  both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
23:

25:  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
26:  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records

28:  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
29:  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
30:  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
31:  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
32:  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
33:  `compact_expand`.

SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

arguments.content:
**Addressed via documentation** (the option you offered): the unconditional `true` is now documented as deliberate on `applyLocalTrimFallback` (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`):

> Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap dimension and runs the healthy LM path.

Rationale for documenting instead of mirroring: the two valves answer different questions. `_runPass`'s `success` drives the classic ladder's "another pass needed?" decision; this valve's boolean drives the over-window funnel's "resume vs abort the live task". Gating it on the under-trigger check would conflate "nothing was droppable" (honest failure — keep) with "trimmed but still over the message cap" (a working, bounded context) — and the latter must NOT abort the session, which is the exact bug gh-1743 fixes. The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"content":"**Addressed via documentation** (the option you offered): the unconditional `true` is now documented as deliberate on `applyLocalTrimFallback` (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`):

> Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap dimension and runs the healthy LM path.

Rationale for documenting instead of mirroring: the two valves answer different questions. `_runPass`'s `success` drives the classic ladder's "another pass needed?" decision; this valve's boolean drives the over-window funnel's "resume vs abort the live task". Gating it on the under-trigger check would conflate "nothing was droppable" (honest failure — keep) with "trimmed but still over the message cap" (a working, bounded context) — and the latter must NOT abort the session, which is the exact bug gh-1743 fixes. The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

{"content":"**Addressed via documentation** (the option you offered): the unconditional `true` is now documented as deliberate on `applyLocalTrimFallback` (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`):

> Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap dimension and runs the healthy LM path.

Rationale for documenting instead of mirroring: the two valves answer different questions. `_runPass`'s `success` drives the classic ladder's "another pass needed?" decision; this valve's boolean drives the over-window funnel's "resume vs abort the live task". Gating it on the under-trigger check would conflate "nothing was droppable" (honest failure — keep) with "trimmed but still over the message cap" (a working, bounded context) — and the latter must NOT abort the session, which is the exact bug gh-1743 fixes. The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"patch":"[lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart#E936]
SWAP 349.=361:
+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

+  /// gh-1743: host-callable emergency valve for a timed-out compaction —
+  /// applies the same mechanical local trim [_localTrimFallback] the
+  /// classic pass ladder ends on (keep the most recent
+  /// [CompactionSettings.keepRecentTokens], repair tool pairing, prefix
+  /// the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass
+  /// receipt and closes the [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone] bracket exactly
+  /// like the `_runPass` trim branch, and reports whether the live
+  /// context was actually bounded. `false` means nothing was droppable —
+  /// the caller keeps its failure verdict.
+  ///
+  /// Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check
+  /// (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the
+  /// trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension
+  /// that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept
+  /// messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the
+  /// over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's
+  /// whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next
+  /// turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap
+  /// dimension and runs the healthy LM path. A cancelled [runToken]
+  /// throws before anything is trimmed or reported (issue #1085 cancel
+  /// parity with [run]).
+  bool applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass = 1}) {
+    // Cancel parity (issue #1085): a cancelled compaction is NEVER a
+    // mere failed pass. If the owning run's token cancelled around the
+    // moment the budget fired, surface the abort instead of trimming —
+    // and reporting success on — a run the user stopped.
+    runToken?.throwIfCancelled();
+    final tokensBefore = _requestTokens();
+    final trimmed = _localTrimFallback();
+    if (trimmed == null) return false;"}

arguments.content:
## Issues/Notes

- All 5 open review threads on this PR are addressed: the one IMPORTANT finding fixed in code, all 4 suggestions fixed in code (two of them as the reviewer-offered documentation option). No owned CI violations — CI was green at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks").
- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart` — `applyLocalTrimFallback`: cancel-parity guard + deliberate-success doc; `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` timed-out exhaustion branch: failed-pass receipt + `onDone` bracket close.
- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart` — nothing-droppable test: `doneCount` + failed-pass receipt pins; rescue test: `droppedMessages: 3` pin; new cancelled-run-token regression test.

{"content":"**Addressed via documentation** (the option you offered): the unconditional `true` is now documented as deliberate on `applyLocalTrimFallback` (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`):

> Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap dimension and runs the healthy LM path.

Rationale for documenting instead of mirroring: the two valves answer different questions. `_runPass`'s `success` drives the classic ladder's "another pass needed?" decision; this valve's boolean drives the over-window funnel's "resume vs abort the live task". Gating it on the under-trigger check would conflate "nothing was droppable" (honest failure — keep) with "trimmed but still over the message cap" (a working, bounded context) — and the latter must NOT abort the session, which is the exact bug gh-1743 fixes. The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- All 5 open review threads on this PR are addressed: the one IMPORTANT finding fixed in code, all 4 suggestions fixed in code (two of them as the reviewer-offered documentation option). No owned CI violations — CI was green at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks").
- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

## Files Modified

The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- All 5 open review threads on this PR are addressed: the one IMPORTANT finding fixed in code, all 4 suggestions fixed in code (two of them as the reviewer-offered documentation option). No owned CI violations — CI was green at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks").
- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart` — `applyLocalTrimFallback`: cancel-parity guard + deliberate-success doc; `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` timed-out exhaustion branch: failed-pass receipt + `onDone` bracket close.
- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart` — nothing-droppable test: `doneCount` + failed-pass receipt pins; rescue test: `droppedMessages: 3` pin; new cancelled-run-token regression test.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-1743 entry narrowed to the total-budget watchdog.

## Test Coverage

- RED verified before each fix: `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` failed with actual `0`; the cancel-parity test failed with "emitted `true`" (the valve trimmed on an aborted run). Both turned GREEN by the fixes above.
- `dart test test/agent/ test/compaction/` → **829 passed** (828 pre-existing + the new cancelled-run-token test).
- `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the per-PR core gate) → green; pre-existing `test/browser_ext/` + `test/integration/` runner-environment failures (no Chrome/D-Bus, CLI-spawn flakiness) were already documented on this PR as unrelated — reproduced on the untouched baseline `806f022` — and remain excluded from the per-PR gate.
- `dart analyze` clean on the touched files; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- All 5 open review threads on this PR are addressed: the one IMPORTANT finding fixed in code, all 4 suggestions fixed in code (two of them as the reviewer-offered documentation option). No owned CI violations — CI was green at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks").
- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart` — `applyLocalTrimFallback`: cancel-parity guard + deliberate-success doc; `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` timed-out exhaustion branch: failed-pass receipt + `onDone` bracket close.
- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart` — nothing-droppable test: `doneCount` + failed-pass receipt pins; rescue test: `droppedMessages: 3` pin; new cancelled-run-token regression test.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-1743 entry narrowed to the total-budget watchdog.

> Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap dimension and runs the healthy LM path.

Rationale for documenting instead of mirroring: the two valves answer different questions. `_runPass`'s `success` drives the classic ladder's "another pass needed?" decision; this valve's boolean drives the over-window funnel's "resume vs abort the live task". Gating it on the under-trigger check would conflate "nothing was droppable" (honest failure — keep) with "trimmed but still over the message cap" (a working, bounded context) — and the latter must NOT abort the session, which is the exact bug gh-1743 fixes. The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).

The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- All 5 open review threads on this PR are addressed: the one IMPORTANT finding fixed in code, all 4 suggestions fixed in code (two of them as the reviewer-offered documentation option). No owned CI violations — CI was green at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks").
- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart` — `applyLocalTrimFallback`: cancel-parity guard + deliberate-success doc; `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` timed-out exhaustion branch: failed-pass receipt + `onDone` bracket close.
- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart` — nothing-droppable test: `doneCount` + failed-pass receipt pins; rescue test: `droppedMessages: 3` pin; new cancelled-run-token regression test.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-1743 entry narrowed to the total-budget watchdog.

## Test Coverage

- RED verified before each fix: `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` failed with actual `0`; the cancel-parity test failed with "emitted `true`" (the valve trimmed on an aborted run). Both turned GREEN by the fixes above.
- `dart test test/agent/ test/compaction/` → **829 passed** (828 pre-existing + the new cancelled-run-token test).
- `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the per-PR core gate) → green; pre-existing `test/browser_ext/` + `test/integration/` runner-environment failures (no Chrome/D-Bus, CLI-spawn flakiness) were already documented on this PR as unrelated — reproduced on the untouched baseline `806f022` — and remain excluded from the per-PR gate.
- `dart analyze` clean on the touched files; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean.

## Review Replies

One reply per open thread in `outputs/review_replies.json` (5/5), each pointing at `outputs/review_replies/thread_*.md` with the fix location.

{"content":"**Addressed via documentation** (the option you offered): the unconditional `true` is now documented as deliberate on `applyLocalTrimFallback` (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`):

> Deliberately NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check (`!shouldCompact && !_overMessageCap`): the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the TOKEN trigger by construction, so the only dimension that can stay over is the gh-1680 message cap (many tiny kept messages). This boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap dimension and runs the healthy LM path.

Rationale for documenting instead of mirroring: the two valves answer different questions. `_runPass`'s `success` drives the classic ladder's "another pass needed?" decision; this valve's boolean drives the over-window funnel's "resume vs abort the live task". Gating it on the under-trigger check would conflate "nothing was droppable" (honest failure — keep) with "trimmed but still over the message cap" (a working, bounded context) — and the latter must NOT abort the session, which is the exact bug gh-1743 fixes. The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- All 5 open review threads on this PR are addressed: the one IMPORTANT finding fixed in code, all 4 suggestions fixed in code (two of them as the reviewer-offered documentation option). No owned CI violations — CI was green at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks").
- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart` — `applyLocalTrimFallback`: cancel-parity guard + deliberate-success doc; `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` timed-out exhaustion branch: failed-pass receipt + `onDone` bracket close.
- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart` — nothing-droppable test: `doneCount` + failed-pass receipt pins; rescue test: `droppedMessages: 3` pin; new cancelled-run-token regression test.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-1743 entry narrowed to the total-budget watchdog.

## Test Coverage

- RED verified before each fix: `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` failed with actual `0`; the cancel-parity test failed with "emitted `true`" (the valve trimmed on an aborted run). Both turned GREEN by the fixes above.
- `dart test test/agent/ test/compaction/` → **829 passed** (828 pre-existing + the new cancelled-run-token test).
- `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the per-PR core gate) → green; pre-existing `test/browser_ext/` + `test/integration/` runner-environment failures (no Chrome/D-Bus, CLI-spawn flakiness) were already documented on this PR as unrelated — reproduced on the untouched baseline `806f022` — and remain excluded from the per-PR gate.
- `dart analyze` clean on the touched files; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean.

## Review Replies

The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

- All 5 open review threads on this PR are addressed: the one IMPORTANT finding fixed in code, all 4 suggestions fixed in code (two of them as the reviewer-offered documentation option). No owned CI violations — CI was green at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks").
- The IMPORTANT finding (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XjR`) was a real residual gap in this PR's own branch: after the gh-1743 rescue, the timeout + nothing-droppable path remained the ONLY terminal path that returned without closing the `AutoCompactorHooks.onDone` bracket — leaving the CLI's HEP `compaction_start` bracket open and `_runTokensBefore` stale (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:192-207`).

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) per finding, no scope expansion:

1. **Close the `onDone` bracket on the exhaustion path** (IMPORTANT thread): RED — extended the nothing-droppable test with `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` (failed: actual `0`). GREEN — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()`'s timed-out branch now mirrors the classic engine's failure branch: after `hooks.onBothRolesFailed(outcome.error!)` it fires the failed-pass receipt (`AutoCompactorPass(..., fallback: null, ok: false, error: outcome.error)`) and `hooks.onDone(adapter.passCount + 1, _requestTokens())` before returning `false`. The CLI's `onDone` now closes the HEP bracket and clears `_runTokensBefore` on this path; the failed `onPass` prints a diagnostic only (no success-looking report), so no user-facing CLI behavior changes.
2. **`runToken` cancellation parity** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XqD`): RED — new test proves a cancelled run token + budget-timeout rescued the run (`true`, trim applied) instead of surfacing the abort. GREEN — `applyLocalTrimFallback` now opens with `runToken?.throwIfCancelled()` (issue #1085 parity with `run()`'s `finally`), at the top of the public method so any future direct host caller gets the same belt; the factory's timed-out branch therefore throws `CancelledException` before trimming, reporting, or failing on a run the user stopped.
3. **Unconditional success documented as deliberate** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xnq` — the reviewer-offered "or documenting why" option): the `applyLocalTrimFallback` doc comment now states why the boolean is NOT gated on `_runPass`'s under-trigger check: the gh-1425 clamp lands the trim under the token trigger by construction, the only residual dimension is the gh-1680 message cap, the boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel (a `false` would abort the live task — gh-1743's whole bug), and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction (which fires on either dimension and runs the healthy LM path).
4. **CHANGELOG narrowed to the actual code path** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5XtE`): "hits its budget watchdog (300s total, or a provider-level kill the engine cannot recover from)" → "hits its total-budget watchdog (the factory's 300s `totalBudget`)". The provider-kill shape survives via the pre-existing classic fall-through, not this change.
5. **Bracket behavior pinned** (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6u5Xwd`): the nothing-droppable test now asserts `doneCount == 1` plus exactly one failed-pass receipt (`fallback: null`, `error` identical to the `onBothRolesFailed` error); the rescue test additionally pins the trim receipt's `droppedMessages: 3` (issue #673 AC3).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart` — `applyLocalTrimFallback`: cancel-parity guard + deliberate-success doc; `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` timed-out exhaustion branch: failed-pass receipt + `onDone` bracket close.
- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart` — nothing-droppable test: `doneCount` + failed-pass receipt pins; rescue test: `droppedMessages: 3` pin; new cancelled-run-token regression test.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-1743 entry narrowed to the total-budget watchdog.

## Test Coverage

- RED verified before each fix: `expect(hooks.doneCount, 1)` failed with actual `0`; the cancel-parity test failed with "emitted `true`" (the valve trimmed on an aborted run). Both turned GREEN by the fixes above.
- `dart test test/agent/ test/compaction/` → **829 passed** (828 pre-existing + the new cancelled-run-token test).
- `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the per-PR core gate) → green; pre-existing `test/browser_ext/` + `test/integration/` runner-environment failures (no Chrome/D-Bus, CLI-spawn flakiness) were already documented on this PR as unrelated — reproduced on the untouched baseline `806f022` — and remain excluded from the per-PR gate.
- `dart analyze` clean on the touched files; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean.

## Review Replies

One reply per open thread in `outputs/review_replies.json` (5/5), each pointing at `outputs/review_replies/thread_*.md` with the fix location.

This boolean answers "does the session live" for the over-window funnel — a `false` here aborts the live task, gh-1743's whole bug — and a still-over-cap context self-heals at the next turn's pre-flight compaction, which fires on the message-cap dimension and runs the healthy LM path.

Rationale for documenting instead of mirroring: the two valves answer different questions. `_runPass`'s `success` drives the classic ladder's "another pass needed?" decision; this valve's boolean drives the over-window funnel's "resume vs abort the live task". Gating it on the under-trigger check would conflate "nothing was droppable" (honest failure — keep) with "trimmed but still over the message cap" (a working, bounded context) — and the latter must NOT abort the session, which is the exact bug gh-1743 fixes. The message-cap residue is self-healing: the next turn's pre-flight gate fires on either dimension (`!shouldCompact || _overMessageCap`), so the healthy LM path re-runs without a timeout.
